input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the \"Term\"). Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
input.rationale: The Agreement renews automatically for successive 1-year terms (renewal term length is fine), but there is no non-renewal mechanic: our only route out of a renewal is the mutual "for any reason" right exercisable on ninety (90) days' written notice after the Initial Term. A 90-day exit window fails the fallback requirement of a non-renewal notice window of no more than 60 days (it sits at the walk-away boundary). We therefore added a Customer-only non-renewal election on 60 days' notice before the end of the then-current Term, leaving Kubient's 90-day notice right unchanged so as not to shorten our own protection. The price-cap element is not engaged: renewal is at the same terms and there is no unilateral price-increase or uplift mechanic (fees are a revenue share set in each Exhibit).

proposal.summary: Add a Customer 60-day non-renewal notice right
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement auto-renews for 1-year terms and our only exit is the mutual 90-day post-Initial-Term notice, so we have added a Customer non-renewal election on 60 days' notice before the end of the then-current Term, consistent with our fallback position of a non-renewal window of no more than 60 days. Kubient's 90-day notice right is untouched.

ops.text: Customer may elect not to renew this Agreement by giving written notice of non-renewal to Kubient at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current Term, in which case this Agreement will expire at the end of that Term.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
